_law: Injected verbatim into every emission. Never paraphrased, never hand-tuned mid-production. Brand names (Hilda, Gravity Falls, Over the Garden Wall) live in the bible for humans and NEVER appear in emissions — brand_block rule, paid for by Crystal Bears renders.
text: Hand-drawn 2D animation. Warm coloured-ink linework in browns, ambers and muted greens — never black outlines. Flat colour fills with a subtle paper texture, as if painted on lightly grained stock. Soft amber-warm palette with honeyed light. Characters are simple, expressive shapes with large readable eyes and distinctive silhouettes; their movement is gentle and slightly springy, drawn on twos. Backgrounds are richly detailed Victorian arcade interiors — ornate ironwork, tiled floors, glass roof light — rendered flat with painted depth, no perspective tricks. Cosy storybook atmosphere with quiet melancholy underneath. No 3D rendering, no photorealism, no painterly brushwork, no cel-shine gradients.
negatives_standing: no watermark, no text in frame
palette_law: Amber-warm inside the arcade and shop, always. Each historical destination gets its OWN locked palette, declared per episode before its first render.
